**Finding: Compliant — no redline needed.**

I reviewed the entire Master Services Agreement (preamble, §§ 1–7 and numbered clauses 8–19) for any covenant that would limit Clear Capital's business lines, products, or fields of use.

**What I checked and why it passes:**

- **No non-compete or exclusivity binding us.** Searches for "compet", "exclusiv", "restrict", "field of use", "engage in", and "Company shall not" turned up nothing resembling a restraint on our business. The only "compet" hit was "court of competent jurisdiction" in the arbitration clause.
- **Clause 13 (p0047)** is the sole restrictive covenant: a mutual employee non-solicitation, term plus one year, limited to personnel with direct involvement in the Services, with consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Reciprocal and outside this rule's scope.
- **§ 4(b)(ii) (p0020)** contains the only other "Company shall not" — barring resale or unrelated use of Contractor's own pre-existing proprietary materials and administrative records. That is an IP licence-scope limit on RadialSpark's property, not a restraint on our business, and it is mitigated by **§ 4(c) (p0021)**, which grants us a royalty-free, perpetual, sublicensable licence to use Contractor's Information in connection with our business operations.
- **§ 4(b) (p0019)** runs in the opposite direction, preserving Contractor's freedom to serve other clients rather than restricting us — a vendor-side provision we have no reason to flag.
- **§ 6 termination (p0032–p0033)** and **§ 4(d) (p0022)** impose no post-term limitation on us; § 4(d) affirmatively confirms we may modify the software and engage others to do so.

Confidence: 0.9. Residual risk sits outside this document — Statements of Work and the incorporated Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (referenced in clause 12) are not in scope here, so any exclusivity or field-of-use language could surface there. Worth screening those on intake.
